spec.assertion: No defPct=120 buffApply is ever emitted. The trigger is a damage-taken counter; the scope-lock boss deals no damage and no attacked/damage-taken TriggerDef exists, so the block can never fire. Fails under the nearest-wrong `passive`/`interval` re-key that emits the (inert) buff anyway. Paired it.skip documents the missing primitive.
Covered by the inertness run: deleting skill1+skill2 leaves every unit's total byte-identical, proving no DEF line was routed into an offensive stat.

Count arithmetic over defPct=80 applications: count(helm) == count(anis) and count(liter)+count(crown) == count(anis) and total == 3x count(anis). Fails under target `allies` (4x), under a missing excludeSelf (anis eats a slice slot so only one ally is covered), and under dropping the "self and" half (anis count 0). Robust to liter/crown flipping in the live-ATK ranking, which a set-equality assertion would falsely fail. helm is provably top-ATK ally: Attacker 118,027 vs Supporter 98,367.

Every application carries durationShots === undefined and a finite expiresFrame. Fails under the round-count mis-encoding ("for N round(s)" semantics) and under a permanent/no-duration passive (expiresFrame non-finite). Plus >= 6 applications, which fails under a one-shot passive-at-t0 encoding (exactly 3).

Structural: the alliesTopAtk target must set count 2, excludeSelf true, byFinalAtk true. Asserted structurally because this fixture cannot discriminate it — static and final-ATK orderings both put helm on top, so no damage-visible consequence exists.

it.skip — no HP pool and no incoming boss damage at scope lock, so the payload is unobservable. Its absence is enforced negatively by the inertness run (any offensive stand-in for it would move totals).
Removing the flatDamage effect drops anis totals (line is live and non-inert); re-pinning atkPct to 156.73 is a byte-exact no-op on ALL unit totals, which fails under any other shipped magnitude.

Every anis burst-bucket damage event has fbMajorApplied === false and rangeApplied === false. Fails under the nearest-wrong fullBurstEnter re-key (which would collect the +50% FB major) and under omitting the rider no-range convention. Structural companion: the carrying block's trigger.kind === 'burstCast', target.kind === 'enemy'.
Forcing core:true on the flatDamage must strictly INCREASE anis totals; equality would prove core was already (wrongly) on.

No buffApply with stat 'damageTakenPct' and value 32 exists. DEF-down is a subtractive term in the formula; damageTakenPct is a multiplicative Damage-Taken bucket that would lift the WHOLE team's damage — the fold is the single highest-value over-credit available on this kit. Paired it.skip records that no enemy-DEF StatKey exists.

fixtures: controlComp('anis', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / anis (carry slot) / helm (B3), boss Fire, focus anis; deterministic, no seed. 5 hoisted runs: base, skill1+skill2 deleted (inertness), burst flatDamage removed (line-is-live), burst flatDamage core:true (core discrimination), burst flatDamage atkPct pinned to 156.73 (exact magnitude). The fixed B3 (helm) is KEPT because anis is Burst II and a chain needs a B3 for any burst to cast at all; helm additionally serves as the provable top-ATK ally for the skill2 target-set arithmetic (Attacker 118,027 > Supporter 98,367). RISK, explicitly guarded: crown is also Burst II and contests anis's burst slot, so a 'fixture sanity' test asserts anis lands at least one burst-bucket hit — if that fails, every burst assertion is vacuous and a comp without a second B2 is required.
gaps: it.skip — enemy DEF ▼32%/5s: StatKey has no enemy-DEF-down key and boss DEF is a subtractive formula term; needs a new stat + a boss-DEF hook. Guarded negatively by the no-damageTakenPct-32 assertion.
it.skip — skill1 'Activates when attacked 40 time(s)': no attacked/damage-taken TriggerDef exists, and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so the condition is unsatisfiable regardless.
it.skip — skill2 'Equally shares damage taken for 10 sec': no HP pool / no incoming damage modeled; payload unobservable.
NOT DISCRIMINATED by this fixture (asserted structurally instead): byFinalAtk vs static ATK ranking — helm tops both orderings, so no damage-visible difference exists.

NOT DISCRIMINATED: skill2's trigger PERIOD. The kit gives no activation clause, so the trigger is an interval whose seconds come from the datamined skill cooldown, i.e. an ALWAYS-⛑ field outside the kit text. Assertions deliberately constrain only target set, duration semantics, and recurrence (>= 2 activations) — never the activation count.
NOT DISCRIMINATED: the burst hit's crit disposition (kit is silent; flatDamage.crit defaults false and no counterfactual was spent on it).

Teammate inertness is asserted only for the skill1/skill2 deletion, NOT for the burst-damage removal — the burst hit generates burst gauge, so removing it can legitimately shift the whole team's rotation.

HARNESS DOC AMBIGUITY (not a kit gap): the packet describes the OverrideFile both as slot → Block[] and as slot → { blocks: Block[] }. The accessors handle both shapes so the ambiguity cannot masquerade as a kit failure; worth reconciling in the packet.

ASSUMPTION flagged: damage-event `srcSlot` is read as the source unit's TEAM-SLOT index (resolved from a buffApply targetSlug/targetIdx pair). If it is instead the SkillSlot string, the fixture-sanity guard fails loudly with that message rather than passing vacuously.
